question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

CONCLUDE
solution:
The correct answer is '**End**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Conclude**' is '**End**'.
 
• **Conclude**: to end or to bring something to an end. (समाप्‍त करना या होना)
 
 
• *Example: The President **concluded** his tour with a visit to a charity concert.*
 
 
 
• **End**: the furthest or last part of something; the place or time where something stops. (अंत; समाप्ति)
 
 
• *Example: My house is at the **end** of the street.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *End.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Exclude**: to leave out; not included. (छोड़ देना; शामिल न करना)
 
• **Open**: not closed or covered. (खुला, अनढका या अनावृत)
 
• **Include**: to have as one part; to contain (among other things). (को समाविष्‍ट करना; साथ में रखना)
 
 

42:T53e,
The correct answer is **'Continue doing something'.**
